summary: Nothing new passed the proof rule this week, and the forward logs are still too young (132 closed ideas over 6 dates; Launch picks 3 open, lined-up buys 11 rows). This week's research (groups running together, RS-high dips, EMA touch odds) is built as information, but most of the dashboard's real edge now comes from one idea measured five different ways: a leader dipping into its 9/21 EMAs inside a leading group, best after a thrust. The best next step is the trade warehouse: one table of every setup's past trades, so we can see which of those overlapping layers actually adds edge, show a stacked expected R on each Launch pick and lined-up buy, and drop the ones that only repeat each other.

items.title: Trade warehouse + stacked expected R on Launch picks and lined-up buys
items.where: new module breadth/warehouse.py (start from tools/rstack/box_stack.py); stack line on launchPicksCard and lineupCard; forward log beside data/lineup_ledger.csv
items.how: One table of every past trade from box retests, springs, lined-up dips (lifecycle trigger), Best Setups nuzzles/flags and Launch replays, all on one yardstick (next-open or trigger entry, same R floor, 20 sessions) with the same layer columns. Expected R = setup base + only the lifts we name in advance and that hold in both halves, shrunk by sample size. Each live pick shows its stack, e.g. '+0.30 base, +0.28 leading group, +0.45 thrust window', and the stack is logged and scored forward.
items.test: Lifts fixed before testing: thrust window, leading group (top 30% 60d), lifecycle BUY, SPY above 50-day, in-vogue theme. Each lift = R with minus without, averaged per date, t at least 2 over 20+ dates, same sign both halves. Then score the stacked R on the second half only: top fifth minus bottom fifth must be positive with rank IC at least 0.05.
items.kill: Stacked R doesn't separate second-half trades (IC under 0.05 or top fifth no better than bottom): show the single proven tags only and stop.

items.title: Clean up the 'dip into the 9/21 EMAs' family: keep what adds edge, fold the rest
items.where: layers dips, rspull, emaprob, polished, stairs vs lifecycle (lined-up buys); Setups tab cards
items.how: Six cards flag almost the same trade: an uptrend leader touching its 9/21 EMAs. Alone the touch has no edge (dips ~0, RS-high dips -0.03R, EMA odds -0.07R); the edge only shows inside a leading / BUY group, best after a thrust. Using the warehouse (#1), check how much each one adds beyond lined-up buys; merge the survivors into one 'Into the EMAs' list with tags and drop the rest from the page. That also saves ~100+ seconds of build time (rspull ~50 s, emaprob ~55 s).
items.test: Warehouse trades that pass the lined-up rule: does adding RS-line high, 2nd weekly-EMA touch, stair-step state or Best Setups nuzzle change R? Per date, both halves, t at least 2.
items.kill: If one of them adds at least +0.15R beyond lined-up in both halves, keep it as a tag; otherwise retire its card.

items.title: Market filters on the new headline picks: volume tilt and hidden buying
items.where: lined-up gate (buy / half / hold in lineup.yml and lineupCard); layers volume_tilt, hidden_buying
items.how: Carried over for the third week, now aimed at what Adam actually trades (the old Top 2 is retired). Both gauges predict SPY's next month. If they also change the R of lined-up dips, the gate drops to 'half size' on 'Buyers tiring' or bottom-fifth hidden-buying days. Just two extra warehouse columns.
items.test: Lined-up trigger trades (stock_evidence.trigger, ~750 in BUY groups) by tilt tier and FINRA dev fifth, per date, both halves, t at least 2; repeat inside mixed breadth only so it isn't just the breadth regime again.
items.kill: |t| under 2, halves disagree, or the effect disappears inside one breadth regime.

items.title: Groups running together as an early lifecycle trigger
items.where: lifecycle WATCH to BUY (lifecycle.group_state) and the runners alert in lineup.py
items.how: Running days beat the average group next day (+0.34%, t 2.25) and over 5 days (+0.90%, t 2.47), both halves. WATCH groups alone have no edge, but 53% turn BUY. Test whether a running day in a WATCH or BUY group is the moment to act (or size up), and whether a running day in a 'forgotten' group is just a one-day pop.
items.test: Daily-bar running events split by the group's lifecycle stage that day (no look-ahead), next open to 5 and 20 sessions vs the average group, per date, both halves, t at least 2. Also check the intraday continuation from data/runner_log.csv once ~4 weeks are logged.
items.kill: Running + WATCH no better than running alone, or halves disagree: keep runners as an alert only.

items.title: Earnings season read: UP clusters in BUY groups
items.where: earnings_clusters (Trade Stories card, story fact sheet)
items.how: UP clusters lifted the members that hadn't reported (+1.9%, t 1.93, halves agree). The planned test is whether that's stronger when the group is already in BUY. Run it once this earnings season ends (mid-November), when most reports are in.
items.test: UP cluster events, non-reporters next close to 20 sessions vs avg group, split BUY vs not, per date, both halves, t at least 2.
items.kill: No difference with BUY: keep the cluster card as information only.

items.title: Live track records and agent layers: first honest read in late November
items.where: data/launch_ledger.csv, data/lineup_ledger.csv, decision_log (catalyst, calendar, macro_brief), trade_stories scorecard
items.how: Nothing to build. Launch picks: 3 open from Oct 26 (AI -3.3% vs SPY, DHR +1.4%, IT +0.2%), next 3 pending (SNPS, CTSH, ASAN). Lined-up: first trades just opened (EOG). Forward agent log: 132 ideas over 6 dates; 'earnings inside the hold' and 'no warnings' point the expected way but are tiny.
items.test: Agent layers: t at least 2 over 20+ dates, same sign both halves. Lined-up: 30+ closed trades vs the +0.84R backtest. Launch: compare to the replay only after 13 weeks.
items.kill: No agent layer reaches |t| = 1 by ~100 settled ideas: cut the catalyst agent to earnings checks only.

items.title: Oct 15 shallow thrust: score it on Nov 13
items.how: The Oct 15 thrust was shallow and 'unconfirmed'; its 21-session result lands about Nov 13. Log it as a new case for both cards.
items.test: Needs 8+ cases before any real test.
items.kill: If Oct 15 behaves like a normal thrust, drop the 'unconfirmed' wording to a footnote.

retire.why: Third week in a row: IC about 0 in both halves on two cards (close-location, who-won-the-close). The tiles say 'no forward edge found'. Hide them; keep the data columns.
Repeat: no forward edge (|IC| at most 0.2, halves disagree, 410 days) and ~40 s per build. Hide or collapse the card; re-test in 6 months.

Its own test says no edge (wick and back ~0, t under 1), and lined-up buys already cover the same 9/21 entry with a tested edge inside BUY groups. Fold the Box/SoW names into lined-up tags or drop the card (see item 2).
